nodes.name: Every 5 minutes
nodes.notes: Layer 3 (improvements 3.7). The outside monitor expects a ping every 5 minutes with a 5-minute grace; when the pings stop it alerts from OUTSIDE. This is the only layer that catches the server, n8n or the scheduler being dead -- a system cannot report its own death. Successes ARE saved: with saveDataSuccessExecution=none n8n 2.28 left every run as an orphan row in status 'running' with no stoppedAt (observed 16 Sep), which reads as a hang. 288 rows a day, pruned at 14 days, is the honest option. The proof the schedule fires is workflow_statistics.production_success and the monitor's last-ping time.

nodes.name: PingHeartbeat
nodes.notes: The URL is an environment variable (compose passes BETTERSTACK_HEARTBEAT_URL from .env), never a value in this file: the file is committed. onError=continueRegularOutput so a transport error (DNS, refused, timeout) reaches AssertPinged and is recorded as a failed execution with a reason, rather than dying silently.

nodes.name: AssertPinged
nodes.notes: Throws on purpose on a non-2xx or a missing URL. No error branch, deliberately: the throw IS the record. When the error workflow (Layer 1) exists it will report this too.
